text: Carolyn, the following provides you with the major initiatives M&SS will be focusing on
-Executive/Industry Overview.....complete and roll out version for Senior
Management (inclusive of Business Planning triggers) and general user
-BA version 1. 1.....complete and implement version 1.1 which includes
functionality defined in original scope but held off so as not to delay the first
release of BA. Key functional enhancements include.....Publish and Subscribe
-BA version 1.2..... design 1.2 deliverable which will offer added functionality
to the end user community and also provide PM forecast and shipment
information through BA. Actual roll out of version 1.2 will be by year-end.
-MapViewer..... provide DataNet users with an easy to use graphical map display
of data output. Release to users is targeted for late August.
-Hierarchical Picker..... develop and release a common picker for brands and geos
across all databases. Release date is projected as late September.
-Conduct the business requirements phase for a future Media Management
system. Actual completion of the requirements phase will be October.
-PMCS 2.0.....complete development for Marketing and begin system testing for
-PMCS 2. 1/SFA Ordering..... complete all requirements and design specifications
-Roll application out to the user community during the September time frame.
